name: testtopboch_multilayer
description: Query flight for the 3-layer project testtopboch (reference layers flown at Z = 500 / 1000 / 2000 m over the default Bochkivtsi map, 150 m/s, nadir). Nadir camera, fixed yaw 0 (= heading of the north-bound reference legs; south-bound legs need the localizer's 180 deg rotation). Altitude is the simulator Z above the base plane, the same axis the reference layers were flown on, so equal Z means equal scale at the same spot; AGL is about 80 m lower on average (terrain relief ~260 m). Vertical rate <= 20 m/s. Extra keys (description, phases) are ignored by the simulator loader and exist for reading the replay report.

phases.label: acquire_1000
phases.note: cold start on the 1000 m layer (main)

phases.label: climb_1000_2000
phases.note: handoff main -> 2000 m layer; crosses 1414 m (equal scale ratio to both)

phases.label: above_top_2400
phases.note: extrapolation 1.2x above the highest layer, then back to 2000

phases.label: below_bottom_400
phases.note: extrapolation 1.25x below the lowest layer (AGL down to ~140 m over hills)

phases.label: oscillate_707
phases.note: 640 <-> 780 m around the 500/1000 boundary: hysteresis, no ping-pong expected
